description:
EgoForce
	

A large-scale egocentric human manipulation dataset with synchronized fingertip force.
EgoForce is the human tactile dataset introduced in
FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity.
Each recording pairs a head-mounted stereo video and two wrist videos with glove
measurements of per-finger force, pressure, bend and orientation for both hands,
aligned frame by frame to the head video.
